wins.text: Record AUM of nearly $10.5 trillion, up $1.4 trillion or 15% YoY; long-term net inflows of $76 billion in Q1, representing ~40% of full-year 2023 flows in just one quarter
Q1 revenue of $4.7 billion increased 11% YoY; operating income up 17% YoY; EPS of $9.81 up 24% YoY
As-adjusted operating margin of 42.2%, up 180 bps YoY and 60 bps sequentially; AUM up $2.5 trillion over 18 months while headcount is flat or slightly lower

Bitcoin ETF (IBIT) launched in January became the fastest-growing ETF in history, gathering $14 billion of net inflows in Q1 and reaching nearly $20 billion AUM; active ETFs drove $9 billion of net inflows
iShares Europe holds ~30% market share of inflows, 2x the #2 player, with $850 billion AUM — larger than the next 5 players combined; technology services revenue up 11% YoY with ACV up 9% YoY

risks.text: Institutional index net outflows of $13 billion concentrated in low-fee index equities as large clients rebalanced amid equity market appreciation; these episodic flows weigh on headline long-term flow totals
Cash management platform saw $19 billion of net outflows in Q1, including ~$14 billion in the last week of March ahead of Good Friday holiday, in line with seasonal institutional money market trends

Annualized effective fee rate was 0.3 bps lower QoQ due to relative outperformance of lower-fee U.S. equity markets, client preferences for lower-fee U.S. exposures, and lower securities lending revenue — creating ongoing fee rate pressure
GIP acquisition still pending regulatory approvals targeting Q3 2024 close; $3 billion of debt issued to fund cash consideration, adding balance sheet leverage ahead of close

Fixed income retail flows below industry proportionate pickup; yield curve inversion and 5% short-term rates keeping investors in cash, delaying reallocation to intermediate and longer-duration fixed income

guidance_items.detail: Headcount expected to be broadly flat in 2024, excluding GIP transaction impact — consistent with January guidance
Core G&A expense expected to grow low to mid-single-digit percentage in 2024, excluding GIP and related transaction costs — consistent with January guidance
Tax rate estimated at ~25% for remainder of 2024, consistent with prior guidance; actual rate may differ due to discrete items
Share repurchases of at least $375 million per quarter for balance of 2024, consistent with January guidance

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Competitive landscape and fee pressure in European ETFs and fixed income retail
Normalized level of performance fees and implications for compensation ratio going forward
Timeline and confidence in returning to 5% organic base fee growth given law-of-large-numbers headwinds at $10T+ AUM
